verification.method: reviewed native outcome regions, independent before/after relations, and isolated audible SysBeep interval
verification.exclusions: desktop and clock; the last scripted native pointer position per checkpoint; blinking insertion caret in editable text; event timestamps and accumulated event counters; initial idle pointer outside the Graphics content

relations.label: return to Graphics restores its original content
Reset Defaults restores the original preference controls and profile
preference input changes the controls and active profile
indexed palette animation recolors existing pixels
direct-color display retains colors when palette animation is unavailable
SysBeep request is recorded on the page
map refresh preserves deferred resource records
released resource reloads to the original loaded state
ReleaseResource changes the visible lifecycle state
first and reset masked sprites and validation readouts agree
Animate Sprite changes the masked source colors
ScrollRect moves the existing raster exactly 24 pixels left
